title: Is a Chinese Implosion Looming?
gist: Navneeraj Sharma argues that China faces a looming perfect storm of political succession crisis, weakening economy and scarce resources to exercise power at home and abroad, with far-reaching global repercussions. Excerpt only.

insights.claim: If current trends continue, the Chinese state will face a political succession crisis, a weakening economy, and insufficient resources to exercise power domestically and project it externally.
insights.speaker: NAVNEERAJ SHARMA
insights.so_what: Tail risk of a Chinese political-economic shock with global repercussions; consider hedging China-linked exposure.

insights.claim: Few dare to speculate publicly about an economic and political perfect storm bearing down on China.
insights.speaker: NAVNEERAJ SHARMA
insights.so_what: Consensus underprices Chinese systemic risk, in the authors' view.
insights.quote: few dare to speculate about it publicly

insights.claim: The past two decades were an era of shocks, including wars from Iraq to Ukraine and Iran, a global financial crisis, a pandemic, and a US president upending the global order, and China could be the next.
insights.speaker: NAVNEERAJ SHARMA
insights.so_what: Frames China as the next in a sequence of global shocks.
